requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for the full stack.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml with health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml, so that the full stack can be started and verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I ping the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a success status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

requirements: R1: Invoke PUT API endpoint from existing UI to update materials.
R2: Invoke DELETE API endpoint from existing UI to delete materials.

slices.title: Patch UI to invoke update and delete endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing the catalog UI patch for this epic, I want to wire existing buttons to PUT and DELETE endpoints, so that users can manage materials.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user updates it via UI, Then the frontend invokes the PUT endpoint.
Given an existing material, When a user deletes it via UI, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE endpoint.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual data correction time from >5 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in.

slices.title: Patch existing code with authentication enforcement
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication mechanism for this epic, I want to patch the existing access paths, so that unauthenticated access is blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they are blocked, Then they are prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authenticated request ratio from <100% to 100%
